The secret ingredient is you. Mix a little generosity with a lot of Eagle spirit to replace the original gym floor, installed in 1999—a well-loved place for PE, games and school gatherings.

The big thing we’re making

A fresh floor for every Eagle.

The original gym floor has served Covenant Christian School since 1999—more than 25 years of learning, playing, competing and gathering.

Now we’re raising funds to replace it and ready a well-loved space for future PE classes, games, school events and community celebrations. Every donation helps.

Three easy ingredients

Your family’s recipe for success

Register, share your personal Booster link with ten people, and work toward your $250 family goal. Matching gifts are welcome; business donations submitted through the fundraiser count toward participating student goals.

Let’s do this together!
1

Register your student

Create a Booster account—or sign in—and get your personal sharing link.

2

Invite ten people

Share with friends, family, neighbors or local businesses. Personal invitations make it easy to help.

3

Raise $250 together

Track your progress and celebrate milestones. Employer matching gifts can help your effort go further.

One family · One big-hearted goal

Every gift moves the gym-floor project forward.

A little extra sprinkle

Every effort gets a cheer

Family goal grand-prize drawing

Meet your $250 family goal for one entry. Each additional $100 raised earns another entry. Grand prizes apply toward 2027–2028 enrollment fees.

  • 1st prize$500
  • 2nd prize$300
  • 3rd prize$200

Families meeting their goal are also entered in the reserved front-row parking drawing.

Weekly student prizes

Highest weekly donations—not cumulative—earn:

  • October 16: Great American Cookie
  • October 23: milkshake of choice
  • October 30: lunch of choice (Chick-fil-A, Moe’s, McDonald’s, etc.)
Open the recipe box for class and family prizes

Class recognition

October 16: most students registered earns a donut party.

October 23: most students donating at least $50 earns popcorn and juice.

October 30: highest donations earns a Favorite Sneaker Pass.

Final class prizes: highest overall total and participation percentage earns a Huck Finn ride; highest percentage meeting family goal earns pizza; 100% registration and participation, with each student raising at least $50, earns ice cream.

Family recognition

October 23: highest weekly family pledges earns a $50 Azteca’s Restaurant & Cantina gift card.

October 30: highest weekly family pledges earns a $50 First Watch gift card. Weekly, not cumulative.

Booster level prizes run October 26–30. See the full parent newsletter for details.

A few kitchen questions

Quick answers for families

Where do I register?

Use the verified Booster portal at mybooster.com/v3. Create an account or sign in to get your personal share link.

How much should our family raise?

Each family is asked to work toward a minimum $250 goal. Families are encouraged to share with 10 people; employers may offer matching gifts.

Can a business gift count toward my child’s goal?

Yes. Corporate donations submitted through the fundraiser count toward participating student goals. Businesses can download the sponsor form above.

How do I order a fundraiser T-shirt?

The last day for T-shirt orders is October 13. There is no ordering link here; contact the school office for details.

Where are all the prize details?

Download the parent newsletter above for the full Recipe Report.

How do I contact the fundraiser team?

llugo@covenantschool.com or 251-633-8055, extension 1006.
